summary: Flat, parked-up kerb, but houses and flats sit 11-12 m away.

best_section.where: North kerb of Ward Street between the two house blocks, mid-stretch

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 12 m away at 57 m, apartments 11 m at 36 m; homes also across the road about 20 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street with cars parked along both kerbs; room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Collector-type street near a busy junction and a school; moderate traffic by day.
drivers.convention: Many cars parked along both kerbs, so a van blends in.

flags: Bus Zone signs apply school days 3:10-3:30pm only
